stemMd: Why does the passage mention making records optional?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To demonstrate that records had no value.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To show how organisers balanced richer information with broad participation.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To replace the seed exchange with a paperwork service.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To prove that beginners cannot observe plants.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To show that all donors opposed the scheme.

explanationMd: Optional and shorter forms respond to concern that detailed requirements would deter people. This shows a practical compromise between information quality and participation. The value of records remains part of the organisers’ reasoning.

distractorRationale.a: The passage explains several benefits of the records.
distractorRationale.d: A beginner-friendly form is offered, not a claim of incapacity.
distractorRationale.c: The forms support the exchange rather than replace it.
